title: What to eat today?
simplified_paragraphs: 今天早上我说：妈妈，早餐我想吃面包、汉堡和可乐。妈妈说：不行，你只能吃面包、鸡蛋和热牛奶。我说：中午能吃汉堡和可乐吗？妈妈说：中午可以吃汉堡，不可以喝可乐。我说：好吧。
traditional_paragraphs: 今天早上我說：媽媽，早餐我想吃麵包、漢堡和可樂。媽媽說：不行，你只能吃麵包、雞蛋和熱牛奶。我說：中午能吃漢堡和可樂嗎？媽媽說：中午可以吃漢堡，不可以喝可樂。我說：好吧。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ shuō： mā ma， zǎo cān wǒ xiǎng chī miàn bāo、 hàn bǎo hé kě lè。 mā ma shuō： bù xíng， nǐ zhǐ néng chī miàn bāo、 jī dàn hé rè niú nǎi。 wǒ shuō： zhōng wǔ néng chī hàn bǎo hé kě lè ma？ mā ma shuō： zhōng wǔ kě yǐ chī hàn bǎo， bù kě yǐ hē kě lè。 wǒ shuō： hǎo ba。
english_paragraphs: This morning I said: Mom, I want to eat bread, hamburger and Coke for breakfast. Mom said: No, you can only eat bread, eggs and hot milk. I said: Can I have burgers and Coke for lunch? Mom said: You can eat hamburgers for lunch, but you can’t drink Coke. I said: OK.
english_full: This morning I said: Mom, I want to eat bread, hamburger and Coke for breakfast. Mom said: No, you can only eat bread, eggs and hot milk. I said: Can I have burgers and Coke for lunch? Mom said: You can eat hamburgers for lunch, but you can’t drink Coke. I said: OK.
